enable_xinput.description: Enable XInput device support for graphic tablets and touch devices

spotlight_color.description: Hex color code for the spotlight fill (RRGGBBAA format)

spotlight_opacity.description: Opacity level of the spotlight area (0.0 to 1.0)

spotlight_border_width.description: Width of the spotlight border in pixels

border_color.description: Hex color code for the spotlight border (RRGGBBAA format)

enable_zoom.description: Enable zooming with mouse wheel or gestures

zoom_level.description: Initial zoom multiplier for the spotlight (0.5 to 2.0)

auto_hide_delay.description: Seconds of inactivity before hiding the spotlight (0 to disable)

position.description: Initial position of the spotlight on screen
